_comment: Sample production overrides for Windows Server / IIS deployments. Copy the needed sections into the real appsettings.Production.json on the server. Do NOT commit real secrets, connection strings, thumbprints or host names to the repository.

ForwardedHeaders._comment: IPs/CIDRs of the reverse proxy in front of Kestrel (e.g. IIS ARR or a load balancer). Leave empty when hosting in-process in IIS; only loopback is trusted by default.
